projectDescription: Inspired by my previous experience at Luxury Presence, a company specializing in websites and marketing services for real estate professionals. I developed my own backend to practice API integration and property data management while showcasing my understanding of the real estate industry and user-focused web development.

A collection of React applications built with Vite to recall my skills in React development, including hooks, state management, and API integration. The collection features 6 projects that are each designed to practice and apply different front-end development concepts using React-Vite.

A collaborative to-do list web application inspired by Todoist, developed as a group project during my studies at KodeGo Bootcamp. As the team leader, I guided the project’s development and collaborated with my teammates to build a productivity-focused application designed to help users organize tasks and manage their daily activities.
